items.title: The kinematically hot, extremely metal-poor C-19 stellar stream in DESI DR2
items.blurb: Using DESI DR2 radial velocities and metallicities to characterize the C-19 stream, whose large velocity dispersion is hard to explain with a purely baryonic, disrupting globular-cluster progenitor.

items.title: Synergising semi-analytical models and hydrodynamical simulations to interpret JWST data from the first billion years
items.blurb: Feeding cold-gas fractions and star-formation efficiencies from the SPHINX20 radiation-hydrodynamics simulation into the DELPHI semi-analytic model to explain the abundance of bright galaxies at z ≥ 11 and the drivers of reionization.

items.title: GLIMPSE: an ultra-faint Pop III galaxy candidate and first constraints on the Pop III UV luminosity function at z ≈ 6–7
items.blurb: A NIRCam-based search across ~500 arcmin² of JWST legacy fields turns up GLIMPSE-16043, a promising ultra-faint Population III galaxy candidate at z ≈ 6.5, and sets first limits on the Pop III UV luminosity function.
